II. No. The students need to study relevant subjects in graduate courses to enroll in post-graduate courses and the students must fulfill such conditions. III. No. There are not enough institutes offering post- graduate courses which can accommodate all the graduates desirous of seeking post-graduate education of their own choice.

options.b: Only I and II are strong
